notes: Valuation inputs use closing prices of 2026-10-02 (Friday; last close before 2026-10-04). Fiscal year ends June 30 (FQ4'26 = Apr-Jun 2026); FY26 = TTM. FQ4 values derived as 10-K FY minus 9M; no restatement found across filings. The step-up from FQ1'23 reflects the Coherent, Inc. acquisition. Reported revenue includes businesses divested during FY26 (gain on sale of business 124.1; proceeds 437.0): FQ4'26 growth +34% reported vs +42% pro forma per the company. FY26 cash flow: OCF only 79.5 (FY25 633.6) as inventories rose 1,437.6 -> 2,581.0 (+80% vs FQ4 revenue +34%); capex 1,102.9 PP&E + 7.2 intangibles; FCF -1,030.6. Net cash = cash 1,162.0 + ST investments 825.0 - debt 3,222.2 (7.9 current + 3,214.3 LT) at 2026-06-30; restricted cash (35.2 current, 571.2 non-current) and operating leases excluded. Adjusted EPS FY26 5.61 vs FY25 3.53 (non-GAAP diluted; methodology refined FQ2'25 with prior periods restated). heavy_dilution: shares outstanding 155.8M (FY25 10-K cover, 2025-08-11) -> 195.8M (FY26 10-K cover, 2026-08-10), +26%, from $2.0B common issuance and conversion of $2.48B mezzanine preferred (proceeds used to repay debt). inventory_build: inventory/quarterly revenue 1.26x vs 0.94x a year earlier; judgment call in a demand ramp, but it consumed nearly all operating cash flow. 2026-08-31 8-K: special PSU mega-grants ($50M target to CEO, $100M total to five executives) tied to share-price milestones through 2030. founder_led=false (CEO Jim Anderson joined from Lattice, per 10-K).
